# Daily Report — 2026-09-01

## Task Completed
Add `update_assessment_instance` tool to complete the CRUD lifecycle for
`asmt_assessment_instance` records. The tool issues a partial PATCH against the
record identified by `instance_id`. Updatable fields: `state`, `due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD
validated), `user` (respondent), `assigned_to`, and `score`. Both `user` and
`assigned_to` accept either a sys_id (32-char hex passthrough) or a `user_name`
string, which is resolved to a sys_id via a sys_user lookup. An empty-body guard
ensures at least one optional field must be provided. A 404 guard returns a clear
error message when the instance does not exist.
